ai_artifacts_proposal_fields_check.name: ai_artifacts_proposal_fields_check
ai_artifacts_proposal_fields_check.value: ("ai_artifacts"."kind" = 'proposal' and "ai_artifacts"."application_state" is not null) or ("ai_artifacts"."kind" <> 'proposal' and "ai_artifacts"."application_state" is null and "ai_artifacts"."review" is null and "ai_artifacts"."review_revision" is null and "ai_artifacts"."receipt" is null)

ai_conversations_identity_creation_uq.name: ai_conversations_identity_creation_uq
ai_conversations_identity_creation_uq.where: "ai_conversations"."creation_key" is not null and "ai_conversations"."identity_id" is not null

ai_conversations_visitor_creation_uq.name: ai_conversations_visitor_creation_uq
ai_conversations_visitor_creation_uq.where: "ai_conversations"."creation_key" is not null and "ai_conversations"."visitor_id" is not null

ai_conversations_owner_check.name: ai_conversations_owner_check
ai_conversations_owner_check.value: ("ai_conversations"."identity_id" is not null) <> ("ai_conversations"."visitor_id" is not null)

ai_conversations_visitor_site_check.name: ai_conversations_visitor_site_check
ai_conversations_visitor_site_check.value: "ai_conversations"."visitor_id" is null or "ai_conversations"."site_id" is not null

resource_acl_role_check.name: resource_acl_role_check
resource_acl_role_check.value: "resource_acl"."role" in ('admin','editor','viewer','read','write','comment','share','export','ai','manage','move') and ("resource_acl"."workspace_id" is null or "resource_acl"."role" in ('admin','editor','viewer'))

resource_acl_source_check.name: resource_acl_source_check
resource_acl_source_check.value: "resource_acl"."source_share_id" is null or ("resource_acl"."document_id" is not null and "resource_acl"."role" in ('read','write','comment'))

workspaces_personal_owner_check.name: workspaces_personal_owner_check
workspaces_personal_owner_check.value: ("workspaces"."kind" = 'personal' and "workspaces"."personal_owner_id" is not null and length(btrim("workspaces"."personal_owner_id")) > 0 and "workspaces"."personal_owner_id" = "workspaces"."created_by") or ("workspaces"."kind" <> 'personal' and "workspaces"."personal_owner_id" is null)
